name: list_unknowns
description: List current residual-unknown heads in deterministic ID order, with optional exact status, severity, and domain filters. Results are complete inline by default; supply offset and limit to page the filtered order. total is the matching-head count and next_offset is null when the page exhausts the result. This is read-only; unresolved, contradicted, and non-truth dispositions remain distinct. An empty registry does not mean retained Evidence has no residual questions; inspect the relevant Evidence or its analysis view.
